capabilities: Filter tasks by query, tag, and status
disambiguation: It groups tasks by the note's frontmatter title rather than the file name.
extras: Runs entirely locally without network requests.
intentEvidence: Collect tasks from across your vault into any note.
problem: Users often struggle to find specific tasks scattered across many notes without manually searching each file.
summary: Task search collects tasks from across the vault, filtering and grouping them based on note properties and live user input.
